description: Reproducible real-repository benchmark configuration. Repositories are cloned on demand from their public URLs into a temporary/cache directory; they are NEVER committed into RepoIntel. Every entry is a public repository with a clear license and public Git history.

clone_policy.method: git clone (shallow allowed via clone_depth when history not under test)

repositories.notes: Canonical Python library: small module count, rich docstrings, well-known API surface.
Real end-user Python CLI application (not a library): plugin architecture, config handling, output processing.
Iconic JavaScript repository: exercises the JS parser path, package.json manifest extraction, npm-style layout.

expected_scale.note: Large multi-module Python codebase; used for scale/performance validation. Shallow clone by default; full history variant available by overriding clone_depth.

repositories.notes: Large multi-module monorepo-style layout (django/* subpackages), ORM layer, middleware chain: ideal for architecture/flow/impact questions at realistic scale.

history_requirements.note: Long-lived repository with thousands of commits; used to validate Git history ingestion, symbol history, and history-intent queries. clone_depth=null means full clone.

repositories.notes: Express is predominantly JavaScript but the modern codebase has TypeScript type definitions; exercise TypeScript parsing and type-resolution paths.
Small JavaScript utility library with thousands of exported functions: ideal for symbol lookup, call-graph, and large-symbol-count coverage.

expected_scale.note: Large Go project; used for Go parsing and large-graph validation. Shallow clone.

repositories.notes: Docker/Moby: large multi-module Go codebase with deep call graph; validates Go parser support at scale.
Modern Python framework with decorators, dependency injection, extensive type hints; good for graph and call-chain questions.

ground_truth_policy: Ground truth is never hand-invented for retrieval scoring: it is derived programmatically from indexed repository facts (symbol -> defining file/chunk mappings taken from the ingestion-produced symbol table).
